caption: The drawing depicts a large, rounded stoneware jug with a narrow neck and small lip at the top, occupying most of the central area. The jug is a light grayish color with blue decorative floral patterns on its front; three main flower shapes are evident, executed in various shades of blue. Near the upper neck, there is an arched inscription in blue that reads "EDDYSON & FENTON" above a number "3," with "BENNINGTON VT" below it. The jug is shown with some light shading to suggest its volume. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller inset illustration of another jug, drawn in monochrome, which has a handle attached to its neck and shoulder. This smaller jug is positioned in a separate outlined rectangular section from the main drawing. The artist’s name “N. Amantea” appears at the lower right corner of the work. The background is a plain, off-white color and the objects are framed within faint rectangular borders.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
